versions.localizedDescription: Dark mode: touch buttons keep their own text colours (the X was light on white)
Merge: cheaper weather drawing, deep forest shade loaded on a thread
Merge server ping and version check

APK like the IPA: arm64 only, same assets, the stripped engine

- The Android preset leaves out what the iOS one does (the lofi pack too)
  and armeabi-v7a, and compresses the native library in the APK.
- The android job builds the engine from .github/engine/custom.py for
  Android arm64 (with Swappy, cached like the other engine builds) and puts
  it, stripped, in place of the official one in the template's godot-lib AAR.
Android wrapper: gradlew is executable (Godot's export runs it)

Typing: no stray iOS keyboard after SOLO, COPY and PASTE buttons

- The classic setup panel's world-name LineEdit stays under the touch
  setup screen (invisible, still tappable); with its own virtual keyboard
  on, a tap landing there (choosing SOLO) opened the iOS keyboard. The
  game opens its keyboard itself, so that one is off.
- The names and the CO-OP text pages are not system text fields, so iOS
  offers no paste: COPY and PASTE buttons while typing (setup screen and
  the CO-OP typing pages), pasting as far as the field takes.
Merge map-zoom-perf: the map opens at once, no dropped frames at minimum zoom

Next-throw icon: on touch the throw button shows it; otherwise under the top row

The small picture of what the next throw sends out was anchored where the
old HUD put it, and after the HUD cleanup it covered the menu button for its
eleven seconds. On touch the throw button already shows that ball or
Pokemon, so the icon now stays away there; with a controller or keyboard it
sits at the top right, one row under the HUD's top row, in screen units
(a FULL_SCREEN holder) like the rest of that row.

Menus: live party strip, A HINT option at the bottom centre, OPTIONS blocks the field UI

- The touch start menu's party strip walks and follows HP (sleeping bag,
  bed, co-op campfire) while it stays open, on the party views' 0.3 s tick;
  eggs show as eggs there (they keep their species). A co-op campfire heal
  refreshes an open POKEMON list too.
- OPTIONS > CONTROLS > A HINT (off by default, touch only): the "A: ..." chip
  sits at the bottom centre; off, nothing polls what A would do.
- An OPTIONS menu open without the game menu (back from MOVE BUTTONS) now
  blocks the field UI, so the next-throw ball icon cannot come back over it.
- status_hud_test: the game clock chip ticks once a second, up to four game
  minutes behind the world, which the check now allows.
